name: drum
title: Drum
summary: A select for an ordered list, like a hardware roller: the picked option lit between two marks.
use: For ordered values worth seeing in context: sample rates, frame rates, tempos.
anatomy: Options fading away from the picked one
Picked option lit in accent text
rules: Only for ordered options; use a select for an unordered list.
The marks and the picked option are the only accent.
accessibility: Adjustable with the arrow keys; the picked option is announced.
